title: DomainTaxonomy
description: ADR 0009 (B1): the operator-curated, OFFLINE domain graph + pairwise conceptual distances that B1's far-framing successor policy selects D_i from. The construction loop never authors or edits this; it is pinned per-thread with a provenance hash. Its coverage is, by design, the operator's concept coverage — an explicit, auditable, un-gameable bound.

domains.description: The native + candidate domains a problem can be mapped into.

distances.description: Symmetric conceptual distances in [0,1], keyed by sorted 'a|b' domain-id pairs. An unlisted pair is treated as unknown (not selectable as 'far'). 0 = same manifold; 1 = maximally distant.

source_provenance.description: Harness-stamped at pin time (taxonomy_sha256:<hash>) so a later construction cannot swap the table it is judged against.
